_meta.description: Seed koleksi rule Dockerfile untuk fitur `bq --fix-dockerfile` (v2). Dirancang untuk collection PocketBase `build_q_dockerfile_rules`. Setiap record = 1 rule yang dijalankan deterministic + dikirim ke Jev sebagai context untuk severity synthesis dan fix approval.

severity_scale.error: Blocker — build gagal atau security risk serius, harus difix sebelum deploy.
severity_scale.warning: Non-blocker tapi melanggar best practice; perlu dibenahi dalam siklus berikutnya.
severity_scale.info: Observasi; bisa jadi intentional. Catatan untuk review.

category_glossary.build: Dockerfile syntax, FROM, RUN, instruksi order — menyebabkan build failure
category_glossary.security: Credential leak, root user, privileged, secret exposure
category_glossary.performance: Image size, layer optimization, cache efficiency, cleanup
category_glossary.compliance: Standar Qoin: EXPOSE, HEALTHCHECK, multi-stage, label

safe_to_autofix.description: Probabilitas aman auto-fix tanpa merusak build logic

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Dockerfile pakai secret id=github_token/github_user (legacy)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Standar compose.yaml modern hanya mount secret id=netrc. Dockerfile yang cat /run/secrets/github_token akan gagal: cat: can't open ... No such file or directory.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Regenerate Dockerfile pakai template modern (netrc-based). `bq --fix-dockerfile`.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Instruksi (ENV/RUN/etc.) sebelum FROM
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Dockerfile HARUS dimulai dengan FROM (atau ARG global). Instruksi lain sebelum FROM: failed to solve: dockerfile parse error.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.detect_hint: First non-comment/ARG instruction appears before first FROM
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Pindahkan semua instruksi ke setelah FROM. Hanya ARG global diizinkan sebelum FROM.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: FROM pakai placeholder REGISTRY01/PROJECT (template unreplaced)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: FROM mengandung literal placeholder yang seharusnya sudah disubstitusi. Docker pull gagal.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Replace dengan registry path aktual atau gunakan ARG + --build-arg.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Instruksi MAINTAINER deprecated
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: MAINTAINER deprecated sejak Docker 1.13. Standar: LABEL maintainer="...".
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Ganti MAINTAINER x ke LABEL maintainer="x". `bq --fix-dockerfile` auto-convert.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Legacy ENV KEY value syntax (tanpa =)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Syntax ENV KEY value masih valid tapi ambiguous. Standar modern: ENV KEY=value.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Convert ke ENV KEY=value. `bq --fix-dockerfile` auto-convert.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Private repo referensi Bitbucket (deprecated)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Qoin migrasi dari Bitbucket ke GitHub. Go mod yang masih referensi bitbucket.org/qoin akan gagal Authentication failed.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Migrate import path ke github.com/Qoin-Digital-Indonesia/*. Update GOPRIVATE.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: WORKDIR di-comment-out
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: WORKDIR /app di-comment menyebabkan COPY dan RUN bekerja di / atau lokasi unexpected. Binary tidak ditemukan.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Uncomment WORKDIR /app. `bq --fix-dockerfile` auto-uncomment.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: id=netrc tanpa target=/root/.netrc
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Tanpa target explicit, secret di-drop ke /run/secrets/netrc yang tidak dibaca git.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Ubah ke --mount=type=secret,id=netrc,target=/root/.netrc.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Pakai ARG GITHUB_TOKEN/GITHUB_USER (credential leak)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: ARG-based github credential leak ke image layer + history. Standar modern: BuildKit secret mount.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Migrasi ke netrc secret mount. `bq --fix-dockerfile` auto-remove ARG.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Go base image versi lama (< 1.22)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Go 1.22+ diperlukan untuk modul Qoin (temporal, otel v1). Base lama gagal go mod download.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Upgrade FROM ke golang:1.22-alpine atau lebih baru.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: FROM ... as ... huruf kecil (standar: AS uppercase)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Docker menerima as lowercase tapi standar pakai AS uppercase. Konsistensi tool CI/CD.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Ubah as ke AS. `bq --fix-dockerfile` auto-fix.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Base image pakai tag :latest (non-deterministic)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Tag :latest bisa berubah. Build hari ini dan besok bisa hasilkan image berbeda.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Pin ke tag versi spesifik (alpine:3.20, golang:1.23-alpine).

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Base image tanpa tag (implicitly :latest)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: FROM tanpa tag secara implisit menjadi :latest. Non-deterministic, sulit reproduce.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Tambahkan tag versi eksplisit ke base image.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Pakai ADD untuk file lokal (gunakan COPY)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: ADD punya behavior hidden (auto-extract tar, download URL). COPY lebih explicit.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Ganti ADD src dest ke COPY src dest. `bq --fix-dockerfile` auto-replace.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Tidak ada instruksi USER (container run root)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Tanpa USER, container berjalan sebagai root. Attacker exploit = akses root.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.detect_hint: No USER instruction in final stage
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Tambah RUN adduser -D appuser && USER appuser di final stage.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: apt-get install tanpa cleanup (image bloat)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: apt-get tanpa clean menyisakan cache 50-200MB+ di layer.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.detect_hint: apt-get install without apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Chain && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* di RUN yang sama.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: pip install tanpa --no-cache-dir (image bloat)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: pip menyimpan cache download di layer tanpa manfaat di container.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Tambah --no-cache-dir ke pip install. `bq --fix-dockerfile` auto-add.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: curl/wget tanpa -f/--fail (error HTTP tidak terdeteksi)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Tanpa -f, curl return exit 0 saat 404/500. Build lanjut dengan file corrupt.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Tambah -f/--fail flag ke curl/wget.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: COPY . . sebelum dependency install (cache bust)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: COPY seluruh context sebelum go mod download/npm install membuat layer dependency selalu re-download.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.detect_hint: COPY . . appears before RUN go mod/npm install
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: COPY go.mod go.sum dulu, RUN go mod download, baru COPY . .

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Tidak ada .dockerignore (build context besar)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Tanpa .dockerignore, seluruh working directory dikirim ke daemon. Build lambat.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Buat .dockerignore yang exclude .git, node_modules, vendor, *.exe.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Terlalu banyak RUN terpisah (>8 layer)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Setiap RUN membuat layer baru. Chain command terkait dengan && untuk reduce layers.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.detect_hint: Count RUN instructions > 8 in final stage
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Gabung RUN terkait dengan && dan \ line continuation.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Tidak ada instruksi EXPOSE
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: EXPOSE mendokumentasikan port container. Tanpa EXPOSE, developer harus menebak port.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Tambah EXPOSE <PORT> sesuai port aplikasi.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Tidak ada instruksi HEALTHCHECK
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Tanpa HEALTHCHECK, docker compose ps tidak bisa tampilkan health status.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Tambah HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost:<PORT>/health || exit 1.

build_q_dockerfile_rules.title: Single-stage build (image berisi build tools)
build_q_dockerfile_rules.description: Tanpa multi-stage, image final mengandung compiler, SDK, build cache. Go image bisa 1GB+ vs 20MB.
build_q_dockerfile_rules.detect_hint: Only 1 FROM instruction AND uses golang/dotnet-sdk base
build_q_dockerfile_rules.fix_hint: Pisah ke builder stage (FROM golang AS builder) dan runtime stage (FROM alpine).
